schema.title: Response Scenarios Internal V1 Scenarios Get

CandidateFeedback.title: CandidateFeedback
CandidateFeedback.description: The only text the candidate reads: no score, no number, no decision wording.

DirectorDecision.title: DirectorDecision
DirectorDecision.description: Logged for audit, never shown to the candidate.

DraftRequest.title: DraftRequest
DraftRequest.description: The transcript and any notes. The interviewer's scores are deliberately absent, and extra fields are refused.

ScenarioBrief.title: ScenarioBrief
ScenarioBrief.description: The public part of a scenario. The hidden motive and the beats stay inside the service.

ScoredInterview.title: ScoredInterview
ScoredInterview.description: One saved set of scores, pseudonymous: no candidate, no names.
